stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The map was simple, but it treated heat as a public problem, not only a private discomfort.”?
options: Understanding nature often begins by learning that common names hide many different lives.
People often react not only to delay, but to not knowing why delay is happening.
The difference between help and shortcut often depends on what happens after the first answer.
Climate adaptation often begins with knowing who needs help and where help exists.
